text: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְהוָה אֶחָד׃
meaning: "Hear, O Israel: the LORD our God is one LORD" (Deuteronomy 6:4). The central affirmation of Jewish prayer, said morning and evening.
purpose: To affirm the oneness at the heart of all things.
when: Morning and evening, and at night before sleep.
note: In prayer the divine name is not spoken as written: it is read Adonai, "my Lord". The Shema continues with Deuteronomy 6:5–9.
source: Deuteronomy 6:4; Hebrew as printed in the Wikipedia article on the Shema; English, King James Version
name: Shema
iast: Shema Yisrael Adonai Eloheinu Adonai Eḥad.
pronunciation: sh-MAH yis-ra-EL a-do-NAI e-lo-HAY-noo a-do-NAI e-KHAD
